item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must act now to prevent that future—not wait until the harm is done.

2. We believe this plainly: Build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. The stakes demand urgent action before these systems are built.

3. We cannot treat superintelligent AI as an ordinary technology. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must make preventing that outcome a priority.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We are facing a choice with consequences measured in human lives. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. That is not a distant abstraction or a risk we can responsibly leave for someone else to manage. It is a future we must work to prevent, starting now. We need serious public attention, clear accountability, and decisions that put people’s safety ahead of the race to build ever more powerful systems. In this newsletter, we share what is at stake and how we can press leaders and institutions to act before catastrophe becomes reality.
